title: Typewriter and Orchard
author: Theo Joubert
blurb: Cyrus Crane, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
